phrase.zh: 顶级AI初创公司发表极少

phrase.en: Meta misses earnings despite AI push
phrase.zh: Meta尽管推动AI仍盈利未达预期

gloss.en: Leading AI startups publish less research, while per-item analysis finds they quietly shape the field.
gloss.zh: 领先的AI初创公司发表的研究越来越少，而逐项分析发现它们正悄然塑造该领域。

why_now.en: You care about LLM research and transparency: today an analysis reveals the biggest AI startups are barely publishing, affecting how you track progress.
why_now.zh: 你关心LLM研究和透明度：今天一项分析显示最大AI初创公司几乎不发表论文，影响你追踪进展的方式。

phrase.zh: 伊朗展示实力，特朗普权衡选项
沙特袭击伊朗支持的民兵

phrase.en: Trump threatens to hit Iran hard
phrase.zh: 特朗普威胁猛烈打击伊朗

gloss.en: Iran fights back harder, Saudi Arabia enters the fray with airstrikes, and Trump weighs military options again.
gloss.zh: 伊朗更猛烈反击，沙特加入战局发动空袭，特朗普再次权衡军事选项。

why_now.en: You have no declared interest in geopolitics, but this is a major shift with global ripple effects; if you follow it, today Saudi airstrikes mark a new actor.
why_now.zh: 你未声明对地缘政治的兴趣，但这是影响全球的重大变化；若你关注，今天沙特空袭标志新参与方登场。
